2607.07510.title: Stability of Flow Models for Graph Signals
2607.07510.paper_summary: Generating signals on graphs requires permutation-equivariant models that exhibit stability with respect to relative structural perturbations. While favorable stability properties of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been well documented, it is unclear how structural errors propagate through the dynamics of continuous generative flow models that are gaining traction for graph signal generation. In this paper, we analyze continuous normalized flow models parameterized by GNNs and show that permutation equivariance is preserved for both the resulting continuous-time ordinary differential equations and their discrete numerical approximations used as graph signal samplers. Our primary contribution is to derive explicit stability bounds on the generated probability distributions, which quantify how relative graph perturbations affect the final sampled signals. Motivated by these theoretical bounds, we introduce a stability-promoting regularized flow matching strategy that actively penalizes the spatial Lipschitz constant of the vector field during model training. Experiments using synthetic smooth signals on stochastic block model graphs and real-world fMRI signals on brain connectomes demonstrate that this bound-oriented approach yields generative models that are more robust to structural noise, without sacrificing output quality.
2607.07510.paper_summary_zh: 生成圖形上的信號需要具有置換不變性的模型，這些模型對於相對結構擾動展現穩定性。雖然圖神經網絡（GNNs）的有利穩定性特性已被充分記錄，但尚不清楚結構錯誤如何通過日益受到關注的連續生成流模型的動態傳播，這些模型用於圖信號生成。在本文中，我們分析了由GNNs參數化的連續正規化流模型，並顯示置換不變性在生成的連續時間常微分方程及其用作圖信號取樣器的離散數值近似中得以保留。我們的主要貢獻是推導出生成概率分佈的明確穩定性界限，這量化了相對圖擾動如何影響最終取樣信號。受到這些理論界限的啟發，我們引入了一種促進穩定性的正則化流匹配策略，該策略在模型訓練期間主動懲罰向量場的空間Lipschitz常數。使用隨機區塊模型圖上的合成平滑信號和腦連接組上的真實fMRI信號的實驗表明，這種以界限為導向的方法產生的生成模型對結構噪聲更具魯棒性，而不犧牲輸出質量。
2607.07510.author: Martin Schmidt et.al.
